summary: Staffing shortages mean airspace around Cardiff (EGFF) is being delegated to London Area Control and Bristol.
text:
DUE TO STAFFING ISSUES THE FOLLOWING AIRSPACE WILL BE DELEGATED
TO LONDON AREA CONTROL (LAC). CTC VIA THE APPROPRIATE LAC SECTOR
GROUP SUPERVISOR WEST ON 01489 612413.
COTSWOLD CTA 1 3 8 9 11 12 13
PEPZE CTA 14
STRUMBLE CTA 2 3 4
BERRY HEAD CTA 1 2 8
SEVERN CTA 1 2
THE FOLLOWING AIRSPACE WILL BE DELEGATED TO BRISTOL
CARDIFF CTA 1-8 ABOVE 6000FT
